title: Interactive 3D GenyCaster identity
changes: The real Qt Setup sidebar now uses a smoothly lit volumetric Glass G with more detailed bevel shading and cleaner edges.
The brand rotates slowly on its own and responds to mouse or touch dragging, with keyboard adjustments and a gentle return to automatic rotation.
Automatic movement respects Reduce Motion. The light and dark materials, setup navigation and Genyleap footer are preserved.
